name: commandcode
label: Command Code
description: Terminal coding agent that learns your coding taste, driven headlessly for workspace tasks

check_ready.not_ready_message: Not configured — sign in with `command-code login`, or set COMMAND_CODE_API_KEY (press e)
check_ready.unreadable_message: Command Code credentials could not be read. Sign in again with `command-code login`, or re-enter COMMAND_CODE_API_KEY in the Configure screen.

env_config.name: COMMAND_CODE_API_KEY
env_config.description: Command Code API key for headless/CI auth. Optional — leave blank if you signed in with `command-code login` instead.

env_config.name: COMMANDCODE_MODEL
env_config.description: Model id to run on. Leave empty for the account default; BYOK models are prefixed with their provider (for example openrouter/deepseek-v4-flash).

env_config.name: COMMANDCODE_EFFORT
env_config.description: Reasoning effort for each run. Leave empty for the model default.

env_config.name: COMMANDCODE_MAX_TURNS
env_config.description: Maximum tool-use turns per message. Leave empty for the CLI default of 100; a run that hits the limit still returns its partial answer.

tagline: Frontier terminal agent with taste. Requires Node.js 22 or newer.
